fields.summary: The plan run for change set 01M5ZNV3 raised two questions: which actors must have their records committed in the build worktree, and how their entries get committed. The arbiter answered with the Decision builder-actor-records-committed-with-leaf: each builder's actor record is committed in the builder's own leaf commit, and only builder sessions are in scope. No owner words were available, so no quotes are recorded.
fields.title: Builder sessions' actor records, planned under autonomous arbitration
